title: Regular Preterite
summary: Talk about completed past actions with regular -ar, -er, and -ir verbs.

sections.heading: When to use the preterite
sections.body: The **pretérito perfeito** describes actions completed in the past: what happened, started, ended, or occurred once. It is the main narrative past tense for events.

examples.pt: Nós assistimos ao filme no sábado.
examples.en: We watched the movie on Saturday.

sections.heading: Regular endings
sections.body:
Remove the infinitive ending and add the preterite endings.

| Subject | falar | comer | abrir |
|---|---|---|---|
| eu | falei | comi | abri |
| você/ele/ela | falou | comeu | abriu |
| nós | falamos | comemos | abrimos |
| vocês/eles/elas | falaram | comeram | abriram |

sections.heading: Spelling changes in -ar verbs
sections.body: Some regular-sounding verbs change spelling in the **eu** form to preserve pronunciation: ficar → fiquei, pagar → paguei, começar → comecei.

keyPoints: Use the preterite for completed past events.
Some eu forms have spelling changes to keep the same sound.

commonMistakes.note: This is correct; remember comeu is past, not present.
Pagar changes to paguei in the eu preterite.
